text: Toronto and East York Community Council on May 2, 2018 adopted Item TE32.87 – "Construction Staging Area on Duncan Street South of Adelaide Street West". As per the Recommendation 9 of Item TE32.87, the existing traffic operations on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and Pearl Street, were reassessed due to community members' concerns regarding safety of road users. Based on the review of existing traffic operations, it was concluded that the existing temporary pedestrian walkway on the east side of Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and Pearl Street, is not being well used for north-south pedestrian movements. The east crosswalk of Adelaide Street at Duncan Street is currently closed because the temporary pedestrian walkway cannot be aligned with the Duncan Street sidewalk to the north, which makes this an unattractive path for pedestrians. As such, it is recommended…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved time extension of the closure of the east sidewalk and a 2 metre wide portion of the northbound curb lane on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and a point 31 metres south, from July 1, 2018 to December 31, 2018. 2. Approved removal of the existing 1.5 metre wide covered and protected walkway within the closed portion of the northbound lane on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and Pearl Street. 3. Approved conversion of existing one-way southbound traffic operations to two-way (northbound and southbound) traffic operations on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and Pearl Street.
